abstract: US productivity growth accelerated to approximately 2.7% in 2025, nearly doubling the 1.4% annual average of the previous decade. This acceleration represents a significant decoupling of output from labor input, suggesting that AI and related technological advances are driving measurable gains in productivity across the economy.
keyFindings: US productivity grew roughly 2.7% in 2025, nearly double the 1.4% annual average of the past decade.
The 2025 productivity growth demonstrates a decoupling of output from labor input, which is the hallmark of productivity growth.
methodology: Analysis of BLS (Bureau of Labor Statistics) data on US productivity metrics for 2025 compared to the 2015-2024 period.
